title:
Modifies the filter expression of the filter panel to include the children assets and emits action to request data.
It is intended to be used when the data grid's dataSpec.dataType has a relationship to a parent asset, like ReliabilityAssetAlert
or ReliabilitySensorAlert.

Required payload:
- targetGridId: The id of the grid to be filtered
- selectedAssetFormFieldName: The name of the field that contains the selected assets in the filter panel (e.g. parent.id)

Optional payload:
- fieldNameMapping: Used to map form field names to grid field names (similar to specifying `componentsToFilterMapping` in the form)
  Example: { "parent.id": "parent.id", "depth": "parent.depth" }

**Note:** The filter panel should have a field to select parent assets, a field to select asset levels,
and a field to indicate whether to include children assets called `includeChildren`.
**Note:** Do not use this epic along with `componentsToFilterMapping` in the filter panel to prevent duplicate fetch calls.
name: SubmitFilterWithIncludeChildrenEpic
